Executed rates and noisy results are also unlogged.

failure_reasons.judge_reason: The model defines assignment error at 0.01 times gamma, but mixes already-sampled frequencies/counts deterministically. This reproduces the confusion-channel mean while omitting its finite-shot variance; it is not faithful sampling from the readout-corrupted distribution.
